thread:
olivia: CI linkcheck is failing on the docs build — can't find fragment `#serialize-kwargs` in /guides/serving.md

mike: saw that. looks like the migration to Docusaurus changed slug rules, underscores get encoded or replaced

olivia: linkcheck output: `404 fragment not found: /guides/serving.md#serialize_kwargs` (note the underscore -> encoded)

docs-bot: Deploy preview 4432: https://deploy-preview-4432--redwood-docs.netlify.app/guides/serving/#serialize-kwargs (404) — full log: https://ci.internal/builds/4432/linkcheck

sam: quick fix: add explicit anchor on the heading — use `## Serialize kwargs {#serialize-kwargs}` in the MDX so the slug is deterministic

lee: Docusaurus relies on remark-slug/rehype-slug to generate ids. during the mkdocs -> docusaurus move some headings lost the explicit slugs, so older links break

mike: pushed a tiny PR that inserts `{#serialize-kwargs}` for the few failing headings and escapes a few inline code fences that were confusing the parser. ran `yarn docs:linkcheck` locally and it's green

olivia: nice. can you also add a note in the migration guide about heading-slug differences? new contributors keep using underscores and then wonder why links 404

mike: yup — adding a short subsection under "Migrating docs" + a one-liner in CHANGELOG. also tweaked CI linkcheck to not flag encoded-underscore false positives (we still fail real misses)

docs-bot: PR merged: #8123 — docs: explicit heading anchors + linkcheck tweak. Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-4432--redwood-docs.netlify.app — build status: ✅ :shipit:

sam: can we backport to the stable branch? this affects v1.2 site pages customers link to

olivia: please backport and add a brief changelog entry. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
